full_prompt_en: A square oil painting depicts a crowded city street after rain, seen from slightly above the level of the nearest pedestrians. The road opens as a pale reflective channel through the center and narrows toward a misty bright distance. On both sides, low rows of buildings and shops soften into gray, green, and warm ochre patches beneath an overcast sky. The left foreground is packed with figures in dark coats and hats, with a vivid orange-red coat and a neighboring emerald green garment making a concentrated flash of color. A dark boxy vehicle stands just beyond them, its roof catching a cool gray highlight. Near the middle, pedestrians cross the damp road in loose clusters, their legs and shadows blending into broken gray reflections. A small red vehicle appears farther back along the central line. On the right, an open motorcar with a black hood, red-orange body, large dark wheel, and visible driver stands at an angle beside the crowd. Another red vehicle marks the far right edge. A man in a black suit and brimmed hat walks toward the viewer in the lower center, providing a firm dark silhouette against the luminous street surface. Behind him, the people and carriages compress into a dense band of small marks, their separate faces disappearing into the bustle. The paint is applied in energetic short strokes and blurred dabs; precise outlines hold only on the closest silhouettes, wheel, and car roof. Diffused daylight falls through the pale distance and glances off the wet roadway, while the crowded edges remain cooler and darker. The overall composition draws the eye down a shining corridor of movement, balancing dark figures and vehicles with scattered warm accents and smoky city light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形油画从略高于近处行人的视点描绘一条雨后拥挤的城市街道。道路在中央敞开成一条浅色反光通道，并向雾蒙蒙的明亮远处收窄。两侧低矮的建筑和店铺在阴云天空下柔化为灰色、绿色和暖赭色块。左侧前景挤满穿深色外套、戴帽子的人，鲜明的橙红外套与相邻的祖母绿衣着形成集中的亮色。人群稍后是一辆深色方盒状汽车，车顶接住冷灰色高光。中央附近，行人成群穿过潮湿道路，他们的腿与阴影融入断续的灰色反光。更远处中央线上可见一辆小红车。右侧，一辆敞篷早期汽车斜停在人群旁，黑色车篷、红橙车身、大型深色车轮和驾驶者都可辨。另一辆红车标在最右边缘。下方中央，一位穿黑西装、戴有檐帽的男子朝观者走来，在发亮的街面前形成坚实深色剪影。他身后，人群和车辆压缩成由小笔触构成的密集带，单独面孔消失在繁忙景象中。颜料以活跃的短笔和模糊点笔铺开；精确轮廓只留给最近的人影、车轮与车顶。漫射日光从浅亮远方落入，在湿路面上掠出亮色，拥挤的两侧则更冷、更暗。整体构图让视线沿着发光的流动走廊深入，以深色人群和车辆平衡零散暖色重点与烟雾般的城市光线。
style_prompt_en: The image has an oil-painted surface of quick broken strokes, soft scumbling, and small bright dabs. Crowded dark masses frame a lighter passage that recedes through atmospheric haze, giving the picture depth without rigid line work. Cool slate gray, smoky blue, muted green, and warm beige dominate; isolated vermilion and orange-red notes pull attention through the composition. Nearby silhouettes have firmer edges and heavier darks, while distant detail compresses into mottled color and nearly dissolves in light. Diffuse illumination produces broad wet-looking reflections and scattered highlights instead of hard cast shadows. The overall treatment is animated and urban in rhythm, with dense peripheral marks held together by a luminous central value structure.
style_prompt_zh: 图像有快速断续笔触、柔软擦涂和细小亮色点笔构成的油画表面。拥挤的深色块围住一条经大气雾气后退的浅亮通道，使画面无需僵硬线条也有纵深。冷石板灰、烟蓝、低饱和绿与暖米色占主导；零星朱红和橙红色点沿构图牵引目光。近处剪影边缘更明确、暗部更厚重，远处细节压缩成斑驳色彩，几乎融于光中。漫射照明产生宽阔、湿润感的反光和零散高光，而非硬边投影。整体处理节奏活跃而带城市感，周边密集笔触由中央发光的明度结构凝聚起来。
theme_en: A crowded city street with early motorcars and pedestrians after rain
theme_zh: 雨后繁忙的城市街道，行人与早期汽车交错
name: William James Glackens
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
